selection: Each tagged requirement and scenario is assigned to its enclosing requirement entry. Paths identify executable implementation checks and bounded model/evidence artifacts; successful trace declarations establish coverage accounting, not a proof of implementation refinement.

CAT-PARSE-EARS.expectation: Ordered complete grammar; structural modals; precise malformed/extension exclusions; preserve existing delta and parent behavior.

CAT-STATEMENT-SPANS.expectation: Fences and metadata never enter statement text; normalized spans map back to exact source; oversize statements remain explicit scope.

CAT-FORMAL-DISPOSITION.expectation: Justification alone does not authorize solver semantics; explicit example fields and scoped postconditions are distinct from refinements.

CGC-NORMALIZE-CLAIMS.expectation: Preserve original clauses, modality, provenance, references, capability and supporting content across normalization.

CGC-OBLIGATION-LEVEL.expectation: SHALL/MUST are mandatory; SHOULD is advisory; MAY records permission and never requires the response.

CGC-FORMAL-SCOPE.expectation: Every selected statement has exactly one disposition; missing/duplicate display identifiers do not merge source identities.

MCA-MERGE-PROVEN.expectation: Existing merge selection/order remains unchanged while enriched statement payload and source identity survive.

MCA-CONCEPT-ACTIVE.expectation: Removed/replaced blocks supply no active discovery content; ineligibility does not imply source removal.

FLA-FORMALIZE-CLAIMS.expectation: Frozen-registry clause formalization; complete attempt capture; partial scope; exit 9 for attempted total failure and no model work for all-ineligible source.

FLA-VALIDATE-SAMPLE.expectation: Reject undeclared/ill-typed/unsupported predicates before solving; retain type-valid logical inconsistency for diagnosis.

FLA-SMTLIB-COMPILE.expectation: Render typed expressions and injective symbols without textual literal rewriting or embedded solver commands.

FLA-SPEC-COMBINE.expectation: Declare compatible symbols once; preserve defensive conflict/identity bounds; invalidate dangling dependencies before Z3; source-map all labels.

FLA-CLUSTER-AMBIG.expectation: Nonvacuous shared-signature clustering; unknown pairs remain unknown; single samples and unstable representatives retain qualifications.

FLA-RUN-LOGIC.expectation: Background prechecks; mandatory-only global model; separate advisories; exact evidence; primary UNSAT survives failed core extraction.

FLA-PAIRWISE.expectation: Guard coexistence before full mandatory-set conflict; actual core attribution; deterministic bounded pairs; no all-input conclusion from SAT.

FLA-COMPLETENESS.expectation: Applicability/family scoped valuation coverage; unrelated ubiquitous rules do not suppress checking; missing expectations yield suggestions.

FLA-SOLVER-PERSIST.expectation: Every primary, deeper, clustering, comparison and auxiliary execution retains exact script, outputs, status and attribution.

FLA-ATTACH-PROMPT.expectation: Untrusted attached source/registry data; source-owned slots; explicit eligible-index matching; preserve bounded degradation and blind context.

FLA-CONCEPT-FREEZE.expectation: Source-order reconcile before batches; immutable registry/hash across every attempt; unresolved additions and collisions remain visible.

FLA-PREMISE-AUTHORITY.expectation: Identity alignment is distinct from premise authority; no inferred positivity/exclusivity/exhaustiveness hardening; conditional identity is labeled.

FLA-TYPED-FRAGMENT.expectation: Exact integer/rational/unit semantics and validated whole-query quantifier-free linear/enum/UF fragment; no unsupported approximation.

FLA-MODAL-TRACKS.expectation: Advisories and permissions excluded from mandatory baseline; permissions may be infeasible without requiring permitted behavior.

FLA-RULE-ACTIVATION.expectation: Detect guarded/unconditional, self and three-rule conflicts after satisfiable guards; distinguish static vacuity from reachability.

FLA-SCENARIO-MEANING.expectation: Concrete positive/prohibited examples are queries, not global assertions; refinements retain guarded obligations.

FLA-ANALYSIS-BOUNDS.expectation: Count all actual scripts/attempts; enforce global pool and context/expression/evidence limits; skipped work remains scope.

STC-GEN-FORMAL.expectation: Generated claims use the same parser/modal/admission pipeline with independently derived context and localized failure.

STC-CROSS-IMPLY.expectation: Aligned compatible satisfiable premises; correct implication direction; scoped aggregate/pairwise results; no vacuous stronger or differences from missing maps.

STC-BLIND-COMPARE.expectation: No original context leakage; formal uncertainty stays terminal; qualitative explanation cannot become formal equivalence.

STC-CONCEPT-ALIGNMENT.expectation: Post-derivation checked identity/unit/scope map; frozen source registries are not mutated or fed alignment back.

STC-PERMISSION-RELATION.expectation: Separate equivalent/broader/narrower/different allowed valuation relations; absent permission remains unmapped; differences qualify capability alignment.

RAE-FORMAL-ATTEMPT-SETS.expectation: Pointer-only invocation index plus separate raw response/normalized IR artifacts for every attempt path and complete failure.

RAE-SEMANTIC-EVIDENCE.expectation: Exact executable queries and content identities; failed auxiliary decoding cannot erase original verdict/evidence.

RAE-FORMAL-STRENGTH.expectation: Complete scope ledger and valuation-strength vocabulary; partial/conditional interpretations remain qualified in final assessment.

RAE-EVIDENCE-ADMISSION.expectation: Capacity reservation before work; required write failure prevents manifest; managed cleanup/checksums and optional-report lifecycle preserved.

RAE-SEMANTIC-VERIFY.expectation: Independent semantic evaluator, real Z3, positive bounded-model witnesses, traceability, parity and fixed-corpus evaluation evidence.
